title: A Negative Result on Gradient Matching for Selective Backprop

anchors.paraphrase_zh: 方法从一次前向候选批中，用最后一层逐样本梯度和 OMP 选择一个加权子集，使其梯度和尽量接近完整候选批的平均梯度。

anchors.quote: We now present an empirical evaluation
anchors.paraphrase_zh: 实验在五种数据集与模型组合上比较梯度匹配、按 loss 选择和无放回随机子集，并显式对齐选择比例。
论文区分固定候选批和按比例扩大的候选批两种预算语义，并补做标签噪声、学习率调优、梯度估计误差和训练时长分析。

LIMITATIONS.pages: 5-6 and Appendix C.4; no dedicated limitations section

anchors.paraphrase_zh: 更小的梯度近似误差没有转化为更好的测试泛化，这直接限制了把梯度匹配质量解释成样本效用。

formulas: min_w ||sum_i w_i g_i - g_bar||_2^2 subject to ||w||_0 <= m
p(loss) = CDF(loss)^beta for the Selective Backprop loss sampler
m = rho M for fixed forward-batch size M
K = H H^T elementwise-multiplied by P P^T for the implicit last-layer gradient Gram matrix
algorithm_steps: Run a forward pass on M candidates and compute each candidate's loss and last-layer gradient embedding.
Use OMP on the implicit gradient Gram matrix to choose at most m candidates and fit nonzero weights.
Normalize selected weights to sum to m, backpropagate only selected examples, and compare against loss-based and uniform random selection under the same subsampling fraction.
Repeat with fixed and scaled forward-batch interpretations, label-noise settings, and method-specific learning-rate schedules.
selection_timing: Selection is online at every training update after a forward pass over the candidate batch; there is no frozen global sample ranking or epoch-level replay pool.
refresh_rule: Every update receives a fresh candidate minibatch and recomputes either loss probabilities, gradient-matching OMP weights, or a uniform random subset without replacement.

budget.unit: backpropagated examples per forward candidate batch
budget.denominator: candidate batch size M, with m = rho M
budget.unique_sample_definition: At one update the random and target selectors choose a subset without replacement; run-level unique identities are not fixed.
budget.repeat_definition: Examples may be revisited through ordinary epoch sampling, but replay repeat-count parity is not an experimental factor.
budget.cumulative_exposure_definition: The fixed-batch design keeps update count constant while changing effective examples per update; the scaled-batch design keeps effective batch size constant while reducing update count by rho.
budget.compute_cost: Gradient matching adds last-layer embeddings and OMP after the same forward pass; meaningful savings require selected m to be well below candidate M because all M still incur forward cost.

random_baselines: uniform subset without replacement from the same candidate minibatch
fixed-batch and scaled-batch random variants under the corresponding update-budget interpretation

counts: 3 random seeds per reported main setting
seed_count.aggregation: Mean curves are shown with the minimum-to-maximum range across the three seeds.

checkpoint_selection: Figure 1 reports maximal test accuracy reached during training rather than a fixed final checkpoint, so the headline comparison contains a checkpoint-oracle element that Stage1 must not copy.

results.claim: 梯度匹配通常优于按 loss 选择，但二者都不能稳定优于同预算随机子集。
results.value: Across five dataset/model combinations and multiple rho values, neither informed selector consistently beats random.

anchor.paraphrase_zh: 主结果明确把随机选择加入同预算比较，否定了更难或梯度更匹配就必然获得更好泛化的推断。

results.claim: 梯度匹配的全数据梯度近似误差更小，却仍未带来相应的泛化收益。
results.value: Gradient matching lowers squared L2 error to the full gradient, while Selective Backprop still fails to outperform random selection.

anchor.paraphrase_zh: 该负结果把优化代理质量和真实模型效用分开，是 Stage1 不把 gradient norm 或 gradient matching 当作 utility 的直接依据。

ablations: loss-based versus gradient-matching versus uniform random selection
fixed forward-batch size versus scaled forward-batch size
clean labels versus injected label noise
shared base learning-rate schedule versus method-specific tuning
subsampling fraction sweep and gradient-estimation error comparison
negative_results: Neither loss-based Selective Backprop nor gradient matching consistently outperforms random selection.
Loss-based selection degrades markedly under label noise.
Lower gradient-estimation error does not imply higher held-out accuracy.
Separate learning-rate tuning yields a similar ordering and also changes epoch budget through schedule stretching.
failure_conditions: The matched full gradient is dominated by common modes rather than rare endpoint-critical tails.
The last-layer approximation preserves an aggregate direction but discards parameter interactions relevant to generalization.
High-loss selection concentrates label noise or irreducible examples.
Checkpoint-oracle reporting or unequal update semantics hide instability across seeds.
limitations: This is selective backpropagation, not additional replay while all base samples remain exposed once per epoch.
The endpoint is maximal test accuracy, not a fixed-checkpoint FN95 safety frontier.
Three seeds support a useful negative result but do not estimate a high-confidence cross-seed success probability.
Random is candidate-subset matched, but run-level unique IDs, repeated exposures and augmentation draws are not Stage1-matched.
stage1_mechanism_zh: 这篇论文应成为 A 层和梯度路线的强制负对照：Stage1 可以计算独立 FN95 目标梯度的正对齐、负对齐和集合匹配，但必须在固定基础顺序、累计 replay 曝光、optimizer steps 与固定 epoch 下，用 R1、R2 和 no-replay 验证真实干预；更低梯度误差本身不获得样本价值资格。
stage1_non_inference_zh: 论文不能推出最后一层梯度方向对 Stage1 无用，也不能推出随机 replay 永远最优；它反驳的是从更高 loss 或更好全梯度匹配直接跳到更好泛化。其 selective-backprop 预算、最大 test checkpoint 和普通准确率均不同于 Stage1，因此只能约束实验逻辑，不能替代 FN95 replay 实验。
